name: Suffolk House, Penang
scope: The main restored Suffolk House in George Town, Penang, with two open gallery levels, a covered ground arcade, parapet and central clay-tile hipped roof.
era: Standing exterior restored to the 1818 architectural form documented in conservation research and published as an aquatint in 1821.

externalReferences.artist: William Daniell after Captain Robert Smith
externalReferences.title: View of Suffolk House, Prince of Wales’s Island

originalReview.notes: Full unmodified planar image of the original printed sheet, including its engraved title and publisher line. Dealer inventory 41466 and the bibliographic folio identify the plate as the 1 January 1821 London publication.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the published Qualla page. Its existing exterior photograph is CC BY-SA, while the original 1821 print provides a clear and independently dated public-domain reference for the main building.
